temperature ranges do not define a joint stability domain or authorize
extrapolation.

## Observation datasets

### alpha\_quartz\_angel\_1997\_table1\_compression

- **Description:** All 23 alpha-quartz unit-cell observations printed in Table 1, including the simultaneously measured fluorite volumes used to determine pressure.
- **Kind:** calibrated\_pressure\_volume\_lattice\_parameters
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Angel; Allan; Miletich; Finger
    - **Year:** 1997
    - **Source:** Journal of Applied Crystallography
    - **Volume:** 30
    - **Locator:** 461-466
    - **DOI:** 10.1107/S0021889897000861
- **Source location:** Table 1, journal page 463
- **Associated EOS records:** alpha\_quartz\_angel\_1997\_bm3\_1
- **Notes:** The paper explicitly treats parenthesized figures as estimated standard deviations. The printed c=5.39692 A at 3.778 GPa is retained verbatim even though it is inconsistent with the same row's volume and c/a and likely represents a source typographical error.
